Inline comments:
Review comments at @crates/sparql-algebra/src/owned.rs:
- Around line 856-859: Update the G::ProjectStar branch in clone_with_memory to
admit the reachable ProjectionVars trie bytes when sharing the existing
variables root, so the clone’s memory admission matches the bytes counted by
raw_owned_bytes_with_memory.

Review comments at @crates/sparql-eval/src/expr.rs:
- Around line 4795-4798: Update the correlated substitution branch around
`row.narrow_to` to avoid collecting every name from the borrowed snapshot into
`names`. Filter the existing row directly against the snapshot, or skip
narrowing when `row` has no bindings, while preserving the current correlated
storage error handling.

Review comments at @crates/sparql-eval/src/governor/soundness.rs:
- Around line 2481-2490: Update the GraphPattern::ProjectStar arm in
NodeAnalysis to avoid materializing a full projected VarSchema and two
intersections for every nested star scope. Reuse a compact scope representation
for free_vars and certainly_bound, or establish a bound before materializing
schemas, while preserving the projection semantics.

Review comments at @crates/sparql-eval/src/modifier.rs:
- Around line 324-329: Update the ProjectionNames::Star branch in the variables
match to check ctx.growth.is_bounded() and use workspace-accounted schema
delivery when bounded, rather than always calling shared_resident(); preserve
the existing behavior for unbounded growth.
